report:
PASS for proposals132–135 in the stated nef domain, relative solely to the inline actual-ample G0 grant. This covers arbitrary-cardinality k, smooth integral projective X, n≥1, every actual nef rational L and canonical reference0, and the entire intrinsic floor E1(θ). It does not accept unchanged original P16.5, an inverse theorem, attainment or uniqueness. The urn passage documents the ample antecedent used in independently reconstructing the nef conclusion associated with premise6; it grants no nef assertion.

Genuine membership was reconstructed as PSH(θ)=∩ε>0 PSH(θ+εh). Forward section embeddings preserve the original scalar because generating canonical section norms have maximum0. For the reverse inclusion, shifted finite continuous ample FS approximants form one directed decreasing net: strict comparison with a finite continuous old minimum gives an open cover, and compactness gives a common later term. This handles poles and avoids the defective general extended-valued flattening lemma. Closed intersections inside a normalized ample cone give genuine compactness and the envelope property. Lemma5.17 remains ample-only. No unbounded intrinsic endpoint is placed in E~1; Remark7.16's distinction is retained.

Bounded inputs belong to a common actual ample E1 space. Actual tensor identities L=(L+H)−H construct signed metric products before limits, with canonical references and continuous dpsh compatibility. At model stages the coefficient is b_F∏r(θr,𝓧+D_r)|F, with b_F=ord_F(t) and v_F=b_F^−1 ord_F|k(X). The collar identity retains its fixed reference term. Multilinearity proves auxiliary independence; positive actual ample perturbations give nef positivity and raw mass V=θ^n. Borel strict-winning locality follows by restricting a finite measure-valued polynomial and extracting its exact coefficients. It does not pass weak convergence through indicators.

For normalized u, C_u=−Eθ(u), positivity of the bounded mixed energy formula gives ∫(−u_k)M(u_k)≤(n+1)C_u. The increasing strict-winning restrictions therefore have full mass V and yield ||M(u_k)−M(u)||TV≤2(n+1)C_u/k. Their limit is Radon and agrees with the bounded operator. Real cofinal floors and constant shifts preserve it. Expanding the bounded nef height gives ∫(−v)M(u)≤2^n(C_u+C_v), first by bounded-test TV convergence, then countable monotone convergence. Thus every intrinsic E1 test is integrable, including endpoints outside E~1.

The normalized I/J and Hölder inequalities are applied first at positive ample ε to bounded actual inputs. Polynomial pairing limits preserve them with dimension-only constants as Vε→V>0. Ordered floors satisfy I(a,b)≤n(n+1)(Eθ(a)−Eθ(b))/V. The relative-J estimate gives uniform vanishing weight tails; bounded-weight TV convergence then proves fixed and simultaneous intrinsic weighted floor limits. Only after these limits are established are the inequalities transferred to intrinsic E1.

For an original decreasing net with E1 endpoint, floor energy continuity proves full decreasing energy continuity. A common upper shift bounds all tail costs, making the TV floor error uniform over the original directed set. Choosing the floor first and the original index second proves weak convergence on the full original C(X^an). For bounded discontinuous floors, integral convergence is separately obtained from the transferred inequality before applying Lemma7.22. Uniform weight tails handle intrinsic weights and simultaneous decreasing weights. More generally, for a genuine decreasing psh weight integrable at the endpoint, polarized intrinsic heights give the lower integral bound; fixed floors give the upper bound. The resulting integral convergence establishes Lemma7.22's antecedent before weighted weak convergence. No arbitrary-Borel-net monotone convergence or restricted test carrier is used.

Finite subset-average polarization identifies common-θ mixed products as limits of actual positive bounded mixed floors. Mixed coefficient locality fixes their restrictions on W_k={all entries>−k}. Positive multinomial domination by the average's top product bounds the complementary mass by O(1/k). Thus their increasing winning-set construction and polarization limit coincide, with full mass, TV floor convergence, every intrinsic test integrable, and arbitrary decreasing mixed weighted-net convergence.

Ample supporting inequalities pass through the bounded nef limits. Decreasing continuous majorants of any intrinsic E1 base then give supporting inequalities at that base. The perturbed envelope lies between u±|t|||f||; its fixed floors converge uniformly and its floor TV errors are uniform for small t. Both quotient signs are consequently squeezed to ∫f M(u). The same majorant argument identifies envelope energy with outer energy.

The bounded ample-height coefficient estimate is uniform on −k≤b≤0. Hence bounded nef energy is weakly usc; continuous divisorial floor maps and an infimum establish intrinsic usc. The stated normalized cost sets {−Eθ≤B} are closed in the genuine compact cone. Positive mixed expansion, with A0=0 at the canonical generic trivial valuation, proves C(au)≤2^(n+1)a²C(u); cofinal scaled floors extend it intrinsically. Actual decreasing convex series prove that integrability of all intrinsic tests bounds their integrals uniformly on C≤1. Scaling then proves dual finiteness, and every top/common-class mixed output has finite dual energy. For raw mass V>0, the objective obeys Eθ(u)−∫u dμ≤−C(u)/2+2^(n+2)Dθ(μ). This proves coercivity without asserting objective usc or attainment. At V=0 all positive common-class products, floor energies and weighted measures vanish; no probability normalization or uniqueness is inferred.

Fresh complete pertinent primary units were checked: BJ v4, March2022, printed pp21,25–26,36–38,42–47,57–63,79–87,91–92; BE v3, January2021, pp50,55–58,65–66; Fujino–Miyamoto v1 Theorem1.4 and its pp4–5 proof; Stacks01Q3's complete proposition/proof. Relevant published BJ units were matched independently. Harmless corrections are the reversed pairing sign in 7.21(ii), the 7.40 limiting reference to 7.21(ii), and algebraic indices/degrees in 3.31/3.33/7.21/7.30; the n=1 Hölder case uses direct Cauchy–Schwarz. The abstract flattening failure is substantial, but the supplied finite-continuous nef argument independently replaces that application. No historical verdict, hash, nonample note or other campaign supplies a premise.

passages.statement: On a normal complete variety over an algebraically closed field, an R-Cartier divisor D is ample iff D^dim(Z)·Z>0 for every positive-dimensional closed integral subvariety Z (Fujino–Miyamoto v1, Theorem1.4). For projective X, Amp(X) is open and convex with closure Nef(X); thus actual rational ampleness is numerical and a nef rational L plus εH is ample for every rational ε>0 and actual ample rational H. On a quasi-compact scheme with ample invertible A, every finite-type quasi-coherent F satisfies F⊗A^m globally generated for all sufficiently large m (Stacks 01Q3).
passages.quote: every positive-dimensional closed subvariety Z ⊂ X.

For projective X over an algebraically closed trivially valued field, canonical line-bundle metrics are continuous with norm-one frames over the corresponding valuation-ring centers. FS scalars have the actual section formula m^(-1)max_j(log||s_j||_triv+λ_j). BJ Definition4.1 defines PSH(θ) as generically finite usc all-point decreasing-net limits of such scalars on actual rational B_i with c1(B_i)→θ. The full PL(X) space is uniformly dense in C(X^an) (BJ v4, Theorem2.2).

BJ Definition4.1 defines PSH(θ) as generically finite usc all-point decreasing-net limits of such scalars on actual rational B_i with c1(B_i)→θ. The full PL(X) space is uniformly dense in C(X^an) (BJ v4, Theorem2.2).

For projective X over an algebraically closed trivially valued field, let E~1 consist of differences of ample finite-energy psh functions restricted to X^lin. The model height pairing extends uniquely to a finite symmetric multilinear pairing on (N¹(X)×E~1)^(n+1), continuous along decreasing nets in one common ample E1(ω), and monotone in each scalar for nef genuine pairs. Signed mixed Radon products represent its PL-test pairing, have mass θ1···θn, are positive for nef genuine inputs in E~1, and are decreasing-net continuous on a common ample E1(ω). Every E~1 test is integrable via its psh representatives. Their model coefficient is ord_F(X0)∏r(θr,𝓧+Dr)|F (BJ v4, Theorems7.14/7.18, Lemma7.15, Proposition7.19).

On a projective integral variety over a complete non-Archimedean field, possibly trivially valued, products of continuous psh-regularizable metrics are positive Radon measures of the fundamental-cycle intersection mass and continuous under uniform convergence of those entries. Signed multilinearity extends them to continuous dpsh metrics, each a difference of continuous psh-regularizable metrics on actual bundles. Their Deligne metric pairing agrees with the model pairing (BE v3, Proposition8.3, Theorem8.4, Definition8.7, Theorem8.18).
passages.quote: on continuous dpsh metrics, with values in signed Radon measure.

passages.statement: For an integral projective n-fold (n≥1) over an algebraically closed trivially valued field and ample rational A, put ω=c1(A), V=A^n, e=E_raw/V, m=M_raw/V, T_a=ω+dd^ca. For a,b,c,d∈E1(ω), I(a,b)=∫(a−b)(m(b)−m(a))≥0 and J_b(a)=e(b)−e(a)+∫(a−b)m(b), J=J_0. Then e(a)−e(b)=Σ_{r=0}^n∫(a−b)T_a^rT_b^(n−r)/((n+1)V); ∫(a−b)m(a)≤e(a)−e(b)≤∫(a−b)m(b); I/(n+1)≤J_b(a)≤nI/(n+1); I(a,b)≤C_n[I(a,c)+I(c,b)]. For α=2^(−n) and B≥max{1,J(a),J(b),J(c),J(d)}, |∫(a−b)(m(c)−m(d))|≤C_n I(a,b)^α I(c,d)^(1/2)B^(1/2−α) and |J_c(a)−J_c(b)|≤C_n I(a,b)^α B^(1−α), with C_n depending only on n (BJ v4,7.27/7.30/7.31).

Let K be compact Hausdorff, μ_i→μ weakly positive Radon measures, and w_i≥0 an increasing net of lsc functions with w_i∈L1(μ_i), w=sup_i w_i∈L1(μ), and ∫w_i dμ_i→∫w dμ. Then w_i μ_i→wμ weakly on C(K) (BJ v4, Lemma7.22).

For smooth connected projective X over algebraically closed trivially valued characteristic-zero k, every nef θ has the envelope property and divisorially compact normalized PSH(θ) (BJ v4,5.20/5.21). Lemma5.17's continuous-envelope equivalence concerns ample ω. Intrinsic floor E1(θ) contains E~1∩PSH(θ), sometimes strictly for nonample θ (Remark7.16).
